reports.title: OGE Energy Corp. reports third quarter 2026 results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: Due to warmer than normal weather, OGE Energy expects to exceed its original 2026 earnings guidance range. OGE Energy now expects consolidated earnings between $2.62 to $2.68 per average diluted share. The guidance assumes, among other things, normal weather for the remainder of the year. OG&E has significant seasonality in its earnings due to weather on a year-over-year basis.
See OGE Energy’s 2025 Form 10-K for other key factors and assumptions underlying its 2026 guidance.
